card.name: P-gp name and 'multi' words
card.fires_on: The final 'p' in P-gp (P-glycoprotein) in drug interaction text. It also fires on a few words that start a multi- or plural-type phrase, such as 'multi' and 'multitudes'.

modes.label: P-gp abbreviation
modes.description: The last letter 'p' of P-gp before inhibitors or substrates in interaction statements.

modes.label: Multi- and linking words
modes.description: Words like 'multi', 'with' or 'of' in general web prose, where a group or plurality is described.

card.writes: It pushes toward 'target' and 'targeting' words, though that link is weak.
card.plain: It marks the end of the abbreviation P-gp in drug interaction text, and a few 'multi' words in general writing.
